title: Running view: expand more than one run at a time

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner feedback with a screenshot, 2026-10-28: in the Running view only the selected run shows its detail (run id, bar and last heard, pipeline, ledger steps), so with several runs the owner can open only one at a time ("kind of lame"). Let the owner expand more than one run at once.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Interview the owner at preflight: how rows expand (a key such as space or e toggles the selected row and keeps it open when the cursor moves; `E` expands or collapses all; or expand every row when it fits), whether the choice survives a refresh and a view switch, how the page and pager keys count expanded rows, and what happens at 80x24 where several details do not fit. Re-anchor from the code (the selected-row detail in overview.go, the row-start bookkeeping from S151). UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/tui; goldens; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
